methods.label: Apply the clockwise quarter-turn coordinate rule
methods.explanation: Rotating a point \((x,y)\) clockwise through \(90^\circ\) about the origin gives \((y,-x)\), so the coordinates of B′ are \((4,3)\).
methods.levelReason: A quarter-turn coordinate rule and taking an additive inverse suffice; formal vectors or trigonometry are unnecessary.

needsNewNodes.description: Calculate point coordinates after a 90° rotation. About the origin, use (x,y)→(−y,x) counterclockwise and (x,y)→(y,−x) clockwise. About another center, calculate horizontal and vertical offsets, rotate those offsets, and recover the image coordinates.
